description: This file defines classes and functions for handling HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously using the httpx library, with support for SSL configuration, connection pooling, and request retries. It appears to be part of a larger project focused on integrating HTTP communication into a language model framework.

classes.description: Handles asynchronous HTTP requests with support for SSL, retries, and custom transports.
